title: CBSE Central Teacher Eligibility Test (CTET) December 2024 Result
intro: Central Board of Secondary Education (CBSE) Are Recently Uploaded Result For the Central Teacher Eligibility Test CTET December2024. All Eligible & Interested Candidates Can Download Result Now in the Given Link Below.
applicationFee: General / OBC (SingleSubject) : Rs. 1000/-
SC / ST / PH(SingleSubject): Rs. 500/-
General / OBC (Both Paper) : Rs. 1200/-
SC / ST / PH(Both Paper): Rs. 600/-
Payment Details: Pay the Exam Fee through Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking Mode.
Paper I: For teaching classes I to V, you need at least 50% marks in Senior Secondary (or its equivalent) with a 2-year D.El.Ed or a Bachelors Degree in Education (B.Ed).
Paper II: For teaching classes VI to VIII, you need a Bachelors Degree with a 1-year B.Ed or equivalent.
Go to the official CTET website ctet.nic.in. Ensure you are on the correct site to avoid fraudulent activities.
Create an Account: Click on the "New Registration" link. Fill in the required details such as name, contact information, and email address.
Generate Login Credentials: After registering, you will receive a registration number and password. Keep these details secure for future use.
Log In: Use your registration number and password to log in.
Complete the Form: Enter personal details, educational qualifications, and preferred exam centers. Ensure all details are accurate.
Choose Papers: Select Paper I, Paper II, or both, depending on your eligibility and preference.
Photograph and Signature: Upload a recent passport-sized photograph and your signature as per the specifications provided (usually JPEG format and specific dimensions).
Other Documents: If required, upload any additional documents like caste certificates or educational qualifications.
Fee Payment: The fee varies based on the category and the number of papers. You can pay via online methods such as debit/credit cards or net banking.
Fee Structure: Check the specific fee details on the official website.
Preview Application: Review all the information entered to ensure accuracy.
Submit Application: Once confirmed, submit the application form.
Download and Print: After submission, download and print the confirmation page and payment receipt for your records.
